testimonialsSection.title: Real stories from people who went through it.

items.name: Mariana Costa
items.text: I arrived in Spain with a suitcase and the feeling that I'd lost who I was. My psychologist was the first person who truly understood what it's like to be a Brazilian immigrant. I didn't have to explain what saudade means.

items.name: Thiago Lemos
items.text: I left law at 38. Everyone around me thought I was having a crisis. The process helped me realize I was actually waking up.

items.name: Renata Figueiredo
items.text: Being a mother far from family is a challenge with no manual. My psychologist gave me tools and, above all, made me feel less alone on that journey.

items.q: How does the matching process work?
items.a: You fill out our detailed questionnaire about your story, life moment, and therapeutic preferences. Our team — made up of psychologists — reviews your profile and suggests 2 to 3 compatible professionals. It's not an algorithm: it's human curation.

items.q: Do the psychologists see patients in Portuguese?
items.a: Yes. All professionals on our platform work in Brazilian Portuguese. Some also work in Spanish, English, or other languages.
Signing up and matching are free. Session prices vary by professional, between R$150 and R$350 (or the equivalent in euros). We don't charge a platform fee on sessions.

items.q: What if the match doesn't work out?
items.a: That happens. If the connection with the suggested professional doesn't click in the first session, our team reviews your profile and suggests new options at no extra cost.

sobrePage.title: About
paragraphs: Travessia was built to give psychologists who work with Brazilians in Brazil and around the world an organized way to run their own practice — instead of relying on scattered spreadsheets, paper agendas, or a dozen disconnected tools.

The platform brings scheduling, clinical records, billing, and patient relationships together in one place, with the extra care mental health data requires: every clinical record stays isolated per professional, and no patient ever sees what isn't theirs.
We're still actively building the platform — new features ship regularly, always guided by what genuinely helps the people running a practice day to day.

termosPage.title: Terms of use
termosPage.draftNotice: This is a draft template, not yet reviewed by a lawyer. Before commercially launching the platform, we recommend it be adapted by a legal professional to applicable law and the company's actual registered entity.

sections.heading: 1. About these terms
sections.body: By creating an account and using Travessia, you agree to these terms of use. They apply to psychology professionals who use the platform to manage their practice, and to patients who access the patient area at their psychologist's invitation.

sections.heading: 2. What the platform offers
sections.body: Scheduling, electronic clinical records, financial tracking, and patient communication tools, organized into plans with different usage limits — described on the plans page.

sections.heading: 3. Professional responsibility
sections.body: Travessia is an administrative management tool. It does not replace the professional's clinical judgment and is not responsible for the content of the records entered, which are the sole responsibility of whoever creates them.

sections.heading: 4. Account and access
sections.body: Each professional is responsible for keeping their password confidential and for any activity on their account. Patient access is granted by the professional and can be revoked at any time.

sections.heading: 5. Cancellation
sections.body: You can close your account at any time from the platform settings. When cancelling a paid plan, access to the corresponding features remains until the end of the already-paid period.

sections.heading: 6. Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Material changes will be communicated by email or through a notice on the platform.

privacidadePage.title: Privacy policy
privacidadePage.draftNotice: This is a draft template, not yet reviewed by a lawyer. Before commercially launching the platform, we recommend it be adapted by a legal professional to applicable data protection law and the company's actual registered entity.

sections.heading: 1. What data we collect
sections.body: Account data (name, email, phone) from professionals and patients, and clinical data entered by the professional (records, session notes, scheduling, and financial information about appointments).

sections.heading: 2. How data is used
sections.body: Exclusively to operate the platform: authenticating access, displaying each professional's schedule and records, and letting patients see their own appointments and any notes the professional chooses to share.

sections.heading: 3. Isolation between professionals and patients
sections.body: Each professional can only access their own patients' data. Each patient can only access their own data — never another patient's, nor internal notes the professional hasn't explicitly marked as shareable. These rules are enforced directly in the database, not only on screen.

sections.heading: 4. Use of artificial intelligence
sections.body: The optional feature to summarize/organize notes with AI sends the note's text to an external AI provider (Groq) for processing. We chose a provider whose policy states it does not retain or train models on data submitted via API. This feature is only used when the professional explicitly triggers it.

sections.heading: 5. Storage
sections.body: Data is stored on Supabase infrastructure, with row-level access control (Row Level Security) enforced in the database.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
sections.body: You can request correction or deletion of your account data at any time from the platform settings, or by contacting us.
